messages:
sasha: Heads-up — CVE-2026-1423 affects grpc-java dependency we vendor in the runtime. Need to decide backport plan for Dedicated + Private images.
omar: Do we have exploitability in our build? Quick scan says server-side deserialization in proto handling.
jen: For Hosted we can rotate fast. For Dedicated customers with pinned images, we need patch images and push via customer-specific registries. For VPC/on-prem customers, we should provide signed artifacts + clear upgrade steps.
sasha: Priorities: 1) SLA customers and critical workloads 2) widely-deployed images 3) everything else. Agree?
lia: Agree. Also a note on KMS: Private nodes that use customer-managed keys may need key rewrap if the image changes any KMS-related env var. That could block automated rollouts.
omar: On on-prem we can't push new images directly. Plan: produce an OCI layout tarball + sha256 and GPG signature that customers can import.
jen: Suggest patch branches like release/1.12.cve1423 and image tags r1.12.4-cve1423-<customer>. Cherry-pick minimal commits only.
sasha: Any objections to cherry-picks vs full merge?
omar: Cherry-pick minimal fix into stable branches. Lower risk for customer images.
ci-bot: Build queued: infra-image pipeline #7823
ci-bot: Build success: infra-image:1.12.4-cve1423 (sha256:abcd1234...)
lia: For air-gapped customers we'll provide signed tarball + documented import steps and the KMS rewrap checklist. Also include fallback instructions if upgrade fails.
sasha: Can security draft a short advisory we can include in customer emails?
security: Draft advisory: "CVE-2026-1423 (grpc-java) — CVSS 9.1. A remote deserialization vulnerability in grpc-java that can lead to malformed proto parsing and potential memory corruption. We have backported the fix and produced patched images for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Contact support for on-prem import instructions and signing keys."
sasha: Thanks. Omar — can you list customers on pinned images needing manual outreach?
omar: Current list: AcmeCorp, NoyaHealth, FinEdge. Reaching out now.
jen: Rollout plan: canary 10% Dedicated pools, run e2e regression, monitor latency/error rates, then 100% if green. Add rollback playbook.
sasha: I'll create the tracker doc with steps: build -> sign -> upload -> notify -> canary -> full rollout -> postmortem. Link: https://redwood.internal/trackers/patch-CVE-2026-1423
lia: One more: audit-logging change — we added correlation_id header for tracing. Need to verify header contains no PII and that RBAC rules don't accidentally allow cross-tenant access in logs.
omar: Good catch. We'll add unit tests and a small log-redaction check in the image verification suite.
sasha: Great. I'll coordinate release notes, customer emails, and ops handoff. :thumbsup:
